Based on the module definition provided, here is the implementation of the AND gate using the standard Verilog logical AND operator.

### Logic Analysis
An AND gate outputs a high signal (`1`) only if both inputs (`a` and `b`) are high. Otherwise, it outputs a low signal (`0`).

### Verilog Implementation

```verilog
module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  output out
);

  // Assign the output to the logical AND of inputs a and b
  assign out = a & b;

endmodule
```
